#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }
    int ce = 0, co = 0;
    vector<int> count;
    for(int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if(a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ce++;
        } else {
            co++;
        }
        if(co == ce) {
            count.push_back(abs(a[i] - a[i+1]));
        }
    }
    sort(count.begin(), count.end());
    int sum = 0;
    int cou = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i < count.size(); ++i) {
        sum += count[i];
        if(sum > B) {
            break;
        }
        cou++;
    }
    cout << cou << endl;
    return 0;
}
